steps.en: Clone the repo; optionally install the script system-wide
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，可选地把脚本装到系统里

steps.en: Pick the interface and set download/upload ceilings in Kbps
steps.zh: 选好网卡，按 Kbps 设下行 / 上行上限

steps.en: Builds an HTB tree on the interface's outgoing side with three priority classes
steps.zh: 在网卡出方向建一棵 HTB 树，分三个优先级类

steps.en: Redirects incoming traffic through the ifb0 virtual device to cap downloads too
steps.zh: 把入站流量重定向到虚拟网卡 ifb0，下行也一起限住

steps.en: Exits; the kernel enforces the caps until cleared or reboot
steps.zh: 脚本退出，内核一直执行限速，直到清除或重启

value.en: One command caps a link's bandwidth, without hand-writing tc qdisc/class/filter rules
value.zh: 一条命令给网卡限速，不用手写 tc 的 qdisc/class/filter 规则

sources: https://github.com/magnific0/wondershaper#installation (git clone https://github.com/magnific0/wondershaper.git, sudo ./wondershaper -a wlp4s0 -u 4096 -d 8192, sudo make install)
https://github.com/magnific0/wondershaper/blob/master/wondershaper (tc qdisc add ... root handle 1: htb, classes 1:10/1:20/1:30 with sfq leaves, IFB="ifb0" ingress redirect)
